text: Thanks for letting me know about the headaches. I've added them to your note next to the pelvic pain. Do they tend to come at a certain time of day?

I'm really sorry you're going through this. Your GP is the best person to look into why it's happening. In the meantime I can help you get your symptoms down clearly. How long has the bloating been there?
That's a helpful detail, thank you. I'll record that it was worse on the second day. Was the pain steady, or did it come in waves?
I know it's hard to put into words. Take your time, there's no right answer. Try describing how it feels, even roughly. What comes to mind first?
You've mentioned three things so far: the pain, the tiredness and the poor sleep. I've saved all three. Which one bothers you most at the moment?
I'm not able to say whether that's connected, but I can note that you noticed both on the same days. That detail may be useful for your appointment. Did anything else happen on those days?
Thanks for being patient with me. I've got the location and the strength now. The last thing I'd like to capture is how long it lasted. Was it minutes, hours, or most of the day?
That sounds painful, and I'm glad you told me. I'll make sure it's in your summary. Do you remember roughly what date it started?
I can only help with describing what you feel, so questions about what it means are best for your GP. I've noted that you'd like to ask them. Is there anything else you want to remember to mention?
Okay, I've updated the note to say left side instead of right. Thanks for correcting me. Does it ever move to the other side?
What a stressful week. I've put down the missed days at work. How many days in total did you have to stay home?
Understood. I won't guess at anything; I'll just record what you tell me. You said it eases when you lie flat. How quickly does it ease?
Sorry to hear that. I've noted that nothing you tried made a difference. Would you like to add what you tried, so your GP can see it?
I appreciate you sharing something so personal. Your note stays in your own words. Would you like me to ask about anything specific, or shall we wrap up?
Good, that's clear. So it's a dull ache, around a 4, mostly in the evenings. I've written that down. Does it change during your period?
I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it once more in a few words? A short phrase is fine.
Thank you for the update. I've logged today's pain as a 6. Compared with last week, is that higher, lower or about the same?
It makes sense to feel unsure. There's no need to decide anything now. I've kept everything safe in your note. What would you like to add next?
Noted, and thanks. I can't comment on what the scan showed, but I can record that you had one and when. Do you know the date?
That's everything I need for now. I've put your answers into a summary you can review. You can change anything before you save it. Would you like to look it over?
